assets.generation_prompt: Create a production game sprite atlas: exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, real transparent alpha canvas, no grid or labels or text. Genuine coarse low-resolution 48x48-sprite RETRO PIXEL ART, drawn with clearly visible square pixel blocks on a consistent grid, using ONLY four neutral grayscale values (black, dark gray, light gray, white). Sharp stair-step pixel contours, hard flat pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, no smooth shading, no 3D rendering, no vector curves, no glow. Serious understated early handheld RPG objects. NO smiling faces, NO anthropomorphic faces, NO cute toy styling, NO rounded sticker style. Each entire sprite must occupy ONLY the centered 60% of its cell, leaving generous transparent gutters on all sides; all parts contained in their own cell. The transparent background is empty, not a checkerboard. Frame order left-to-right row-by-row: row1: 0 silver minnow side profile, 1 carp side profile, 2 pufferfish side profile, 3 striped angelfish side profile. Fish have tiny single natural pixel eyes, no expressions, no oversized heads. Row2:4 catfish,5 deepwater lanternfish with small lure,6 angular glass aquarium with water and 3 small fish silhouettes,7 same empty aquarium. Row3:8 simple wooden fishing rod with line and hook,9 narrow upright bobber,10 same bobber with two angular bite splashes,11 bait tin with worm. Row4:12 small rocky fishing bank with reeds and a few square water pixels,13 small seashell and pearl,14 fishing net,15 upgraded metal fishing rod. Match all16 in the same monochrome pixel grid. Keep rod and line intact with ample margins. No faces anywhere on tools, shells, rocks, or tanks.
assets.edit_prompt: Rebuild this atlas on an EXACTLY SQUARE 1:1 canvas, with exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal square cells. Preserve the same sixteen objects in the same row/column order and the serious monochrome pixel-art style. Make each object smaller and center it individually, so every sprite fits in the center 60% of its own square cell with at least 20% completely empty margin on ALL sides. Make all pixels outside the actual object FULLY TRANSPARENT. REMOVE all gray haze, glow, vignette, shadow, and environmental background everywhere between objects. No backdrop or checkerboard. Keep sharp pixel edges, no smooth drawing, no faces, no smiles. Do not crop or trim the final square canvas; all four outer gutters must be equal. The final grid must remain SQUARE 4 by 4 for direct sprite slicing, not a landscape arrangement.
